name: Paco's Buffet
headline:
Mexican buffet in
Fort Wayne, all you can eat.
leadText: Paco's Buffet at 1531 Goshen Ave, Fort Wayne. Customers say fresh, authentic dishes, friendly service and a big parking lot.
reviews: This Mexican buffet was absolutely amazing! The food was delicious, full of flavor, and there were so many great options to choose from. Everything tasted fresh and authentic.
We loved the buffet, always wanted a Mexican food buffet. Good options and adding more daily. Found our new fav spot.

Great price for everything I got. Incredibly nice service. Very clean. Fresh food (and that's with going for a late dinner). Same quality as you would get at most Mexican restaurants in town but at a buffet.
Top notch, not your typical buffet food, authentic as it gets, did not disappoint.

theme.note: red and green from the restaurant's own logo

services.d: Customers describe a wide spread of hot, fresh dishes, with more added daily.
Reviews name caldo de res, albondigas and all-you-can-eat menudo.
Reviews name birria (goat or beef), tamales, quesadillas, flautas, chips and queso.
Customers mention a greeter and servers who bring drinks and tortillas for tacos.

qa.a: A customer wrote on Google: “Caldo de res, albondigas, birria goat or beef, tamales, quesadillas, chips and queso, flautas.” Menu changes, so call (260) 209-3969.
A customer wrote on Google: “Everything tasted fresh and authentic.”
A customer wrote on Google that the location is easy to find, “with a huge parking lot.”
